content:
✅ कल है आवेदन करने की अंतिम तिथि – 29 July 2026

Railway RRB Technician Online Form 2026 – Link Active | कल Last Date

  • Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 29 July 2026 (कल)
  • Total : 6557 Posts
  • Eligibility : 10th Pass (post-wise ITI / Diploma as per CEN)

Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have released CEN 02/2026 for recruitment of Technician Grade-I (Signal) and Technician Grade-III – total 6,557 posts.

जिन अभ्यर्थियों ने अभी तक फॉर्म नहीं भरा – कल अंतिम मौका है। आज या कल 29 July 2026 से पहले Submit कर लें।

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 29 July 2026 (कल)
  • Exam Date (CBT) : As per RRB schedule
  • Admit Card : Before CBT

Vacancy (approx.)

  • Technician Grade-I (Signal) : ~323
  • Technician Grade-III : ~6234
  • Grand Total : 6557

Eligibility

10th Pass candidates with prescribed ITI / trade qualification can apply for most Grade-III posts. Grade-I Signal may need Diploma / Degree as per CEN. Always read official CEN 02/2026 before applying.

Age Limit

Generally 18–33/36 years (as on crucial date in CEN) with SC/ST/OBC/EWS and other relaxations.

Selection Process

CBT → Document Verification → Medical Examination.

How to Apply (अभी / कल से पहले)

  1. Open https://www.rrbapply.gov.in
  2. Click CEN 02/2026 Technician Apply Online (Link Active)
  3. Register, fill form, upload documents, pay fee
  4. Submit before 29 July 2026 – कल अंतिम तिथि
  5. Keep application printout safe

Apply only on official RRB portal rrbapply.gov.in. कल last date hai – delay mat karo.
